$comment: Canonical Threads posts the live suite resolves against. Edit this file, not the test.
Run with: npm run test:live   (hits threads.com; excluded from `npm test`)
name    what the case is for — say what is DIFFERENT about it, not what it is
url     any Threads link: canonical, ?xmt-decorated, or a /share/ short link

code    the shortcode the url RESOLVES TO — the part after /post/ in the canonical URL.
          For a /share/ link this is NOT the id in the share URL: /share/InQUBOY9S/
          resolves to code DcTZYVBkhjU. Run `npm run test:live` after editing; the
          suite rejects a share id pasted into this field.
kinds   media the parser must find, in order: "image" | "video" | "audio"
use [] for a post with no downloadable media, e.g. a text post
covers  why this post earns a slot — the behaviour that regresses without it
Prefer posts you own or that are unlikely to be deleted; a deleted post fails the
suite, which is a signal to swap it, not a code defect. When swapping, keep the

posts.name: canonical URL with an ?xmt tracking param
posts.covers: tracking params must not break shortcode extraction

posts.name: /share/ link to a 2-item video carousel
posts.covers: share links resolve server-side to canonical; multi-item carousels

posts.name: /share/ link to a text-only post
posts.covers: a post with no media resolves cleanly instead of erroring

posts.name: /share/ link to a single video (@raycastapp)
posts.covers: the ordinary single-video case; a share id that differs from the shortcode

posts.name: voice post
posts.covers: audio lives at audio.audio_src, outside both versions arrays, and is served as video/mp4

posts.name: image-only post served as WebP
posts.covers: a .jpg URL whose bytes are WebP — the extension must come from the header

posts.name: mixed carousel served as JPEG, with no Content-Length
posts.covers: Threads serves image/jpeg on some posts and omits Content-Length; the progress toast falls back to bytes

posts.name: mixed carousel, video first
posts.covers: carousel items keep payload order and mix kinds

posts.name: 7-item carousel alternating image and video
posts.covers: the largest carousel we test; proves order is preserved across many alternating kinds
